_about: What a banned player reads (the owner, 2026-10-22, after a player banned 1 h for friendly fire was shown "You are banned (Use / distribution / advertisement of prohibited software). Pretending to be administrator of the game."). The client shows st_login_menu_status_user_banned then the reason text, joined with no space. The header named prohibited software for every ban: it becomes "You are banned. " (the space before the reason). st_ban_reason_administrator (0x1C, the login server ban code for a reason with none of its words) said the player pretended to be an admin: it becomes "Decision of the administration.", the neutral text srp meant it to be. Six localization tables each.
